output.reason: The cited bullet [ev-73ba76ce6428] names only the metric, but its section intro [ev-1f419676f177] states the change concretely. Metrics listed there that start with `cortex_` will start with `loki_` in this release. Operators can keep the `cortex_` prefix by changing `metrics_namespace` from its default `loki` to `cortex`, a setting that is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. That gives the subject (the emitted metric `cortex_ring_members`), the change (renamed to `loki_ring_members` through the default namespace), the applicability (environments that leave `metrics_namespace` at its default) and the consequence (anything that queries the old `cortex_` name no longer matches unless the operator acts).
